page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with 16 dedicated physical cores and 1 thread per core, providing 16 vCPUs with dedicated CPU allocation. The system memory capacity is 64.0 GB, which establishes a resource density of 4.0 GB of memory per core.

This instance integrates a single NVIDIA P4 graphics processing unit with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be handled via network-attached block storage. The baseline network bandwidth is rated at 3 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Qualitatively, the dedicated CPU allocation combined with a single GPU provides a balanced resource configuration for workloads requiring hardware acceleration without the cost of high-end multi-GPU setups. This hardware profile is suited for workloads such as entry-level machine learning inference, video transcoding, and GPU-accelerated database operations.
